name: John Wick 1-4 Music Pack
description_html:
WARNING: DUE TO GOOGLE DRIVE DELETING FILES WHEN UNZIPPED DOWNLOAD BOBBY’s MUSIC PLAYER FIRST AND THEN THIS MOD. MOVE ONLY THE AUDIO FILES NOT THE DLL. ALT SOLUTION: Download the ZIP files from my link in Bobby’s Mod Page and then unzip them to a folder or desktop

Music mod adds in the OST from all 4 Movies from the John Wick Series. I deleted some unfitting music from the Pack as well. All credit goes to creators of the Wick series and artists. Updated to 3.10.X SPT version.

Install Instructions: Drag Bepin folder into SPT Directory

Preview: https://youtu.be/IBvf7KUEZ78?si=VCW5_qanSf-EPQPV

Enjoy killing the Goons to this!
